description: Meta test for the runner itself (issue #834 acceptance criterion: 'gate 本身有一支 meta 測試：invalid mutant（編譯失敗）不得被判為通過'). The patch introduces a deliberate C# syntax error next to the same blockedFields symbol. Proves run_mutant.py treats a non-compiling patch as an invalid mutant / gate FAILURE, never a pass -- run_mutant.py --expect-verdict is used to assert on the runner's own verdict, not on any real security behaviour. Never included in the main 'mutants' job.
target_symbol: _FrameworkController.UpdateModelProperty -- deliberately broken `blockedFields` declaration (does not compile, by design)
